regions.today: It will remain generally dry this evening with variable amounts of cloud. Mist and fog will begin to develop too, mainly across north-western parts. All in light variable breezes.
regions.tonight: Mainly dry tonight, with areas of mist and fog, turning dense again in some parts. These mainly in central and northern parts of the region. Lowest temperatures of 1 to 7 degrees with light easterly or variable breezes, though moderate to fresh along southern coasts.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Monday, will be a little milder and breezier than previous days. Mist and fog will once again lift to leave a dry day for most, with bright or hazy sunny spells developing. Highest temperatures of 8 to 13 degrees, with light to moderate easterly breezes.
